description: This is a set of unit tests for the AsyncPipeline class, focusing on throughput, concurrency, and capacity management. It uses Xunit framework for testing asynchronous pipeline behaviors.

classes.name: AsyncPipelineTests
classes.description: Contains test methods to validate asynchronous pipeline behavior including throughput, capacity limits, and concurrency handling.

methods.name: AsyncPipelineSimpleTest
methods.description: Tests basic add and wait behavior of the AsyncPipeline, verifying timing constraints.

methods.name: AsyncPipelineWaitTest
methods.description: Verifies that tasks submitted to the pipeline complete properly, including concurrent tasks.

methods.name: TimedCompletions
methods.description: Creates an array of delay tasks with cumulative waits, used to simulate timed task completions.

methods.name: AsyncPipelineSingleThreadedBlackBoxConsistencyTest
methods.description: Tests pipeline consistency and capacity handling with a specified number of worker threads.

methods.name: AsyncPipelineBlackBoxConsistencyTest
methods.description: Performs a black-box test for performance, timing, and capacity constraints, ensuring pipeline adherence to specifications.

methods.name: CheckPipelineState
methods.description: Checks current pipeline size against capacity and sets flags if capacity is reached.
